items.mainDefect: In the identity-first flow, PasswordForm.render now calls webauthnAuth.fillContextForm for a user who has only typed a username, so the unauthenticated response contains per-user WebAuthn data. This lets anyone enumerate accounts that have passkeys and can expose their credential IDs.

secondary.defect: The relaxed isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()) guard in UsernamePasswordForm.challenge no longer checks whether a user is already selected, so the typed user's passkey data is put into the form before any credential is verified.

items.mainDefect: The wrong-password re-auth tests check only for 'Invalid password.', which does not depend on the relocated setupReauthenticationInUsernamePasswordFormError. They never assert USERNAME_HIDDEN or REGISTRATION_DISABLED, so they would still pass if that method broke.

secondary.defect: No test covers the new setupReauthenticationInUsernamePasswordFormError call site in WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator.errorChallenge, which runs when a passkey fails during prompt=login re-authentication.
